producer_report.summary: The CHANGELOG R5 entry now gives file counts for each name that crossed the S1-S3 seam, and the counts are equal before and after. They exclude the new `run/producer.rs`, and the entry says so. I also fixed a run-on line in the early-returns bullet. No code changed in this send-back, and `cargo test -p xtask --test policy` passes.

Run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core -- --list`. The test names and count equal those of the base commit, and `produce_and_verify_order_tests::a_fake_job_takes_its_baseline_before_the_producer_and_numbers_the_invocations_in_order` passes.
